reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per product, numbered within its category from the lowest cost
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur, product_id) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2

FROM products
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur, product_id) <= 2
other_way.tradeoff: QUALIFY filters the window result in the same query, which is shorter, but PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL Server do not accept it.
